name: io.github.BrightbeamAI/chap
title: CHAP Coordinator
description: Auditable records of human decisions over AI agent work. Approvals, edits, overrides, escalations.

packageArguments.name: --url
packageArguments.description: Forward every call to a running CHAP server's JSON-RPC endpoint, such as a create-chap-app desk server's, where a person decides on the assistant's work. Without it the server runs its own coordinator.

environmentVariables.name: CHAP_PARTICIPANT
environmentVariables.description: The participant every call is made as. Defaults to agent:assistant, the agent a create-chap-app mcp-gate project joins. A call naming anyone else is refused, and so is a human: URI here, since a person decides in a desk.

environmentVariables.name: CHAP_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to a SQLite file; a leading ~ is the home directory. Without it, and without --url, the coordinator runs in memory and workspaces are lost when the client restarts.

environmentVariables.name: CHAP_PROFILES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated CHAP profiles enabled on new workspaces. Defaults to Core plus review, whisper, deliberation, handoff, control, routing, modes and audit-scitt.
